title: Lived-In
description: Boho salon: sand and terracotta, arched photographs, soft serif headings. Closest in spirit to hartisan.hair.

tokens.HERO_HEADLINE: Hair that looks better the longer you wear it
tokens.HERO_LEDE: Soft, sun-touched colour and cuts that grow out well. Made for people with better things to do than style their hair.
tokens.ABOUT_TEXT: I work from a small studio with plants in the window and one client in the chair. We talk first, and I never hurry a colour.
tokens.QUOTE: If you need me again in four weeks, I did it wrong.
tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: A one-chair studio for lived-in colour and low-effort cuts.
